name: Near-Degenerate Sliver Triangle with Long Side Labels
constraint: Generate an SSS triangle with sides 0.05, 0.06, and 0.109 (nearly collinear) and label each side with a 28-character string like 'opposite-side-length-value-A'.
rationale: Probes two known failure modes simultaneously: the near-degenerate sliver geometry collapses interior angles close to 0° and 180° (risking label-overlap and stroke-scaling breakdown), while the excessively long side labels stress-test clipping and layout on a figure with almost no interior space.

name: Near-Degenerate Sliver Triangle
constraint: Generate a triangle with sides 100, 99.5, and 1. Label all sides and all three angles (two angles will be near 0°, one near 180°). Add a right-angle mark on the largest angle.
rationale: Probes sliver/near-degenerate rendering: extreme aspect ratio will stress label overlap, stroke scaling, and the right-angle mark placement on an angle that is explicitly NOT 90° (inconsistent spec).

name: Inconsistent SSS + False Right-Angle Mark
constraint: Generate a triangle question using SSS with sides 5, 5, 12 (violates triangle inequality) AND apply a right-angle mark at the vertex between the two sides of length 5; ask for area.
rationale: 5+5 < 12 breaks the triangle inequality, and the right-angle mark contradicts any realizable geometry. Tests whether the system detects the inconsistency, refuses gracefully, or silently renders nonsense.

name: Circle with Central Angle and Chord
constraint: Generate a circle with radius 7. Place two named points P and Q on the circumference at 40° and 160°. Draw the chord PQ, label it, draw radii OP and OQ, and mark the central angle POQ.
rationale: Covers the core circle capability surface: named circumference points, chord, labeled radius/diameter, and central angle in a single diagram.

name: SAS Triangle with Circumscribed Circle
constraint: Generate a triangle defined by SAS: sides 6 and 8 with included angle 55°. Add a circumscribed circle with the three tangent intersection points marked.
rationale: Tests the combination of SAS specification with an optional circumscribed circle overlay, validating that the circle's geometry is derived correctly from the triangle's computed vertices.

name: Overdetermined Inconsistent Triangle (SSS vs. False Right-Angle)
constraint: Generate a triangle with sides 5, 12, and 14 (not a right triangle) but with a right-angle mark explicitly placed at the vertex between sides 5 and 12.
rationale: Directly triggers the known sensitive area of over-determined/inconsistent specs: the side lengths contradict the right-angle mark. Tests whether the renderer flags, ignores, or crashes on the conflict.

name: Extremely Long Vertex and Side Labels
constraint: Generate a regular pentagon (n=5) where each vertex label is a 24-character string (e.g., 'VertexAlpha_TopLeft_001') and each side is labeled with a decimal value like 1234567.89. Check all labels are visible and unclipped.
rationale: Stresses text clipping and layout: very long vertex names combined with large numeric side labels on a compact polygon are likely to overflow bounding boxes or collide.
